rows.transcript_gb_en_m:
Stand up and stretch your arms up to the sky. Push away any clouds and let the sun shine down on you. Stretch to both sides. Stretch to the front and to the back.

Let your hands hang by your side. Squeeze your shoulders tightly up to your ears as you breathe in, scrunch your eyes, and hold your breath. Release your shoulders as you relax your body.

Relax your arms and let them swing sideways while you turn your upper body. Your arms should gently hit your back as you twist from side to side.

Place one foot in front of the other and make small circles from your ankles – remember to turn to both sides. Do each foot with four circles in each direction.

Now shake your whole body as fast as you can. Shake it up high! Shake it down low! Shake it all around!

Close your eyes and raise your arms slowly above your head as you breathe in. Lower your arms slowly to your side as you breathe out.

Take a moment to reflect on your experience.

Well done! You can do this activity at any time whenever you feel like you need to release stress and energise your mind and body.
rows.transcript_my_ms_m:
Sekarang, sila berdiri dengan selesa.

Berdiri dan regangkan tangan anda tinggi ke atas, seolah‑olah menyentuh langit. Tolak jauh “awan‑awan” yang ada dan bayangkan cahaya matahari menyinari anda. Regangkan ke kiri dan kanan, ke depan dan ke belakang.

Biarkan tangan jatuh di sisi tubuh anda. Angkat bahu anda rapat ke telinga sambil menarik nafas, kerutkan mata anda sedikit, dan tahan sekejap. Lepaskan bahu perlahan‑lahan dan rasa tubuh anda mula tenang.

Longgarkan tangan dan biarkan ia berayun ke kiri dan kanan sambil anda memusingkan badan. Biarkan lengan anda menyentuh belakang dengan lembut setiap kali anda berpusing.

Seterusnya, letakkan satu kaki di hadapan kaki yang lain. Angkat sedikit kaki tersebut dan gerakkan pergelangan kaki membentuk bulatan kecil. Pusing ke arah jam dan lawan arah jam. Ulang empat kali untuk setiap kaki.

[Berhenti seketika selama 5 saat]

Sekarang goncangkan seluruh tubuh anda sekuat yang anda mahu. Goncang ke atas! Goncang ke bawah! Goncang ke semua arah!

Pejamkan mata dan angkat tangan perlahan‑lahan ke atas sambil menarik nafas. Turunkan tangan perlahan‑lahan ke sisi sambil menghembus nafas.

Luangkan masa seketika untuk rasa apa yang berubah dalam tubuh anda.

Syabas! Aktiviti ini anda boleh lakukan pada bila‑bila masa sahaja untuk melepaskan tekanan atau mahu menyegarkan tubuh dan minda.

text_1_facilitator.eng: How can you support your child online? Here’s a quick question to get you going!

quiz_1_question.eng: True or False: Parents should set time limits on how long their child can use the internet each day.

quiz_1_feedback_1.eng:
🎉 Correct! 

⏰ Setting time limits can help balance online activities with other important tasks, such as homework, chores, and physical activities.

📝 You can create rules together with your child about when they can play with devices and how to keep them safe online.

quiz_1_feedback_2.eng:
❌ Incorrect. 

⏰ Setting time limits can help balance online activities with other important tasks, such as homework, chores, and physical activities.

📝 You can create rules together with your child about when they can play with devices and how to keep them safe online.

quiz_2_question.eng: Here is another question to consider. True or false: If your child comes across something upsetting or uncomfortable online, they should keep it to themselves and not tell anyone.

quiz_2_feedback_1.eng:
❌ Incorrect. 

💡 If your child encounters something distressing or inappropriate online, they should tell you immediately so you can address the issue and get support if needed.

quiz_2_feedback_2.eng:
✨ Correct! 

💡 If your child encounters something distressing or inappropriate online, they should tell you immediately so you can address the issue and get support if needed.

quiz_3_question.eng: Social media is everywhere - and children often want to be a part of it too. True or false: It is safe for young children to have their social media accounts without parental supervision.

quiz_3_feedback_1.eng:
❌ Incorrect. 

🔑 Social media platforms have age restrictions for a reason. 

👀 Young children should not have social media accounts without parental guidance and supervision, as they may encounter inappropriate content or interactions.

quiz_3_feedback_2.eng:
⭐ Correct!

👀 Young children should not have social media accounts without parental guidance and supervision, as they may encounter inappropriate content or interactions.

text_1_facilitator.eng:
Keeping your child safe online is an important step to help them be part of the digital world. 📱

Here are 4️⃣ tips that can help keep your child safe online: 
1️⃣ LEARN
2️⃣ PROTECT
3️⃣ BUILD HABITS
4️⃣ BUILD TRUST

🔑 Today, we are learning about LEARN and PROTECT. 

✨ The next lesson will cover BUILD HABITS and BUILD TRUST.

section_1_title.eng: LEARN the dangers of being online

section_1_text.eng:
🚩 CONTENT: Your child might come across harmful content, such as violence, hateful speech, pornography, wrong information, or hating women, people with disabilities, or other races, religions, sexualities, or from other countries.
🚩 CONTACT: Adults might pretend to be children and ask for sexual pictures or to meet with your child through an online platform.
🚩 CONDUCT: Sometimes, children or strangers can say or do hurtful things online.

section_2_title.eng: PROTECT and keep your child safe online

section_2_text.eng:
✅ Talk to your child about which apps and websites are safe and which are not. Discuss why!
✅ Help your child learn how to make strong passwords to protect their devices. 
✅ Tell your child that they should keep personal information private, including photos or videos of themselves. What goes online, stays online!
